theorem conv {X Y T : Scheme.{u}}
    (π : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom π] (p : Y ⟶ T) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (h : Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat p ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward π).obj F)) :
    Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (π ≫ p) F := by
  set J := {r : T.Opens × Y.Opens // IsAffineOpen r.1 ∧ IsAffineOpen r.2 ∧ r.2 ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ r.1}
    with hJ
  have hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ j : J, x ∈ π ⁻¹ᵁ j.1.2 := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hpU, -⟩ :=
      exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := p.base (π.base x)) (U := ⊤) trivial
    have hmem : π.base x ∈ p ⁻¹ᵁ U := hpU
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hVle⟩ :=

    (fun j : J => j.1.1) (fun j => j.2.1)
    ?_ hcover ?_ hU hW eW

  · intro j
    sorry

end Probe
